stories.title: Six-site scheduling rollout
stories.situation: Contoso Freight ran six warehouses on paper rosters, and late trucks backed up every Monday.
stories.task: I was asked to move all six sites to one scheduling system without stopping a shift.
stories.action: I ran it one site at a time, trained a lead at each site first, and kept paper as a fallback for two weeks.
stories.result: All six sites moved over in five months. The case study, with numbers checked by my former manager, is public.
stories.reflection: I would bring the site leads in before choosing the system, not after.

stories.title: Testing AI answers about logistics
stories.situation: AI tools gave confident answers about freight rules that were often wrong, and nobody could say how often.
stories.task: I wanted a repeatable way to score those answers before anyone relied on them.
stories.action: I built route-eval, an open source tool with a set of checked logistics questions, and published every release.
stories.result: Fourteen releases and two outside contributors so far. It is why I want to help AI companies deploy well.

stories.title: Pushing back on the peak staffing plan
stories.situation: For the 2024 peak season the plan was to add overtime across all six warehouses.
stories.task: I thought overtime would burn people out and asked to test a different roster first.
stories.action: I showed the regional manager last year's overtime data and proposed a two-week trial at one site.
stories.result: The trial worked and became the plan for all six sites; overtime fell by about 12 percent.

stories.title: Fixing my own headline
stories.situation: My LinkedIn headline said I led a team of 40. It was 8; the 40 was everyone on the program.
stories.task: A consistency check caught it, and it would have undercut everything else I claimed.
stories.action: I corrected the headline and checked every other number against my CV and my referee.
stories.result: Every number I use now matches across my CV, LinkedIn and site.
stories.reflection: I now write the number first and the sentence second.
